g.text: † Bounded by the resolved time origin: the value in effect at the instant the new

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #16232e

g.text: rows will occupy, not the variable's last value in the timeline as a whole. That is

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #16232e

g.text: what lets an operation be interwoven and still see the state that precedes it.
